Streaming chat completion that includes a usage summary in the final chunk

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ messages: [{ content: "Say hi", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4", stream: true, streamOptions: { includeUsage: true } });
  console.log(result.chunks);
  console.log(result.streamContent);
  console.log(result.usage?.totalTokens);
}

void main();
```
